reviews.text: I went to Stephen & Co. for the first time recently and had the best experience. Sofia did my balayage, and she absolutely nailed it—natural, blended, and exactly what I was hoping for. She was kind, professional, and made me feel completely at ease. The salon itself is beautiful and welcoming. I’m already looking forward to going back!

Not only is Heather fun and outgoing, but she’s also a true color genius. She’s done a few balayages for me, and the blending and dimension are flawless every time! I highly recommend her to anyone looking to elevate their hair color. She also gives excellent tips on products and maintaining healthy hair, which I really appreciate!

Megan was recommended to me after someone else messed up my hair, and I’m so glad I went to her! She did an absolutely amazing job fixing it. She’s professional, talented, and really listened to what I wanted. I left feeling confident and so happy with the results. Megan is awesome—I highly recommend her!
